\end{itemize}
For the identity to hold for large $p$, we must have LHS $\approx$ RHS. This means $p^{k^3} \approx p^k$. Since $k>1$, this implies $k^3 = k$, which only holds if $k=1$. This contradicts the assumption that $k>1$. Therefore, $a_n$ cannot grow faster than linearly.

**2. Analysis of Slower Than Linear Growth:**
